 d=arclog.diff(ss[i-1].board,ss[i].board)
 gp=[t for t in d if t[1]<60]; bar=[t for t in d if t[1]>=60]
 ys,xs=np.where(ss[i].board==12)
 print(i,ss[i].action,'diff',len(d),'gp',len(gp),'bar',len(bar),bar,'avatar top',(int(xs.min()),int(ys.min())))
print('latest bar11 cells',int((b==11).sum()),'row cols',np.where(b[61]==11)[0].tolist())
# differentiate ring11 and bar11
print('bar range',np.where(b[61]==11)[0][[0,-1]])
print('hud code',np.array([[int(np.all(b[y:y+2,x:x+2]==9)) for x in (3,5,7)] for y in (55,57,59)]))
